lines.text: خوانند وصورت دیگر راس اللبره وحامل راس الغول خوانند بیست و شش ستاره است
lines.en: They call it, and another constellation is called Ra's al-Librā (Head of the Balance) and Hāmil Ra's al-Ghūl (Bearer of the Demon's Head). It has twenty-six stars.

lines.text: و خارج صورت سه ستاره و این صورت مردی است بر پای چپ خود ایستاده است
lines.en: And outside the constellation are three stars. And this constellation is a man standing on his left foot.

lines.text: و دست راست بر سر نهاده و بدست چپ سری زشت گرفته و انرا سر غول خوانند وصورت
lines.en: And he has placed his right hand on his head, and in his left hand he holds an ugly head, and they call it the Head of the Ghoul. And the constellation

lines.text: دیگر ممسک العنان و صورت مردیست ایستاده بیکدست تازیانه گرفته و کوکب او چهارده است
lines.en: Another is the Holder of the Reins (Mumsik al-'Inan), and it is the constellation of a standing man holding a whip in one hand, and its stars are fourteen.

lines.text: و از انجمله کوکبی است روشن از قدر اوّل و انرا عیوق خوانند وصورت دیگر
lines.en: And among them is a bright star of the first magnitude, and they call it Capella ('Ayyuq). And another constellation

lines.text: حوا است بیست و چهار کوکبست و خارج او پنج کوکبست و اینصورت مار افساست و صورت
lines.en: is Ophiuchus (Hawwa). It has twenty-four stars, and outside it are five stars. And this constellation is the Snake Charmer (Mar Afsa). And the constellation

lines.text: دیگر مار افساست و انرا حیه خوانند هجده کوکبست وصورت دیگر سهم
lines.en: Another is the Snake Charmer, and they call it the Serpent (Hayya). It has eighteen stars. And another constellation is the Arrow (Sahm).

lines.text: خوانند پنج کوکبست بر صورت تیری دیگر عقاب خوانند نه کوکبست و خارج آن
lines.en: They call it, it has five stars in the shape of an arrow. Another they call the Eagle ('Uqab). It has nine stars, and outside it

lines.text: شش کوکبست و از کواکب او شرطای پر است و انه کوکب اند بر یکخط وصورت
lines.en: are six stars. And among its stars is the condition of the feather, and they are stars on one line. And the constellation

lines.text: دیگر قطعه الفرس خوانند چهار کوکبست وصورت دیگر فرس اکبر خوانند بیست کوکب
lines.en: Another they call the Piece of the Horse (Qit'at al-Faras). It has four stars. And another constellation they call the Greater Horse (Faras Akbar). It has twenty stars.

lines.text: است و اینصورت اسبی است که او را سر و دو دست بود و کفل و دو پای نه
lines.en: And this constellation is a horse that has a head and two hands, and a rump and two feet, no.

lines.text: وصورت دیگر مراة المسلسله بیست و سه کوکب بد صورت زنی ایستاده و دستها بان شکم
lines.en: And another constellation is Mar'at al-Musalsalah (Andromeda). It has twenty-three stars in the shape of a standing woman, and her hands to her belly

lines.text: و زنجیری بر دو پای او نهاده و بعضی گویند زنجیر بر دست اوست وصورت دیگر
lines.en: And a chain is placed on her two feet, and some say the chain is on her hand. And another constellation

lines.text: مثلث چهار کوکب بر مثال مثلثی که او را طولی باشد اینست صورت کواکب شمالی امّا
lines.en: is the Triangle (Muthallath). Four stars in the example of a triangle that has length. This is the constellation of the northern stars. But

lines.text: بروج اوّل حمل مع سیزده کوکب دیگر ثور سی و سه کوکب و بر آن از قدر اوّل در دست دیگر
lines.en: the zodiac signs. The first is Aries (Hamal) with thirteen stars. Another is Taurus (Thawr), thirty-three stars, and on it of the first magnitude in the other hand.

lines.text: جوزا هجده کوکبست و خارج ان هفت کوکب بد شکل دو کوکب ایستاده و دست بدوشها
lines.en: Gemini (Jawza) has eighteen stars, and outside it are seven stars in a bad shape, two stars standing and hands on shoulders.

lines.text: یکدیگر نهاده سرطان هفت کوکب و خارج ان چهار کوکب اسد بیست و هفت کوکب و خارج
lines.en: placed on each other. Cancer (Saratan) has seven stars, and outside it are four stars. Leo (Asad) has twenty-seven stars, and outside

lines.text: ان هشت کوکب قلب الاسد در قدر اوّل در و سنبله بیست و هشت کوکبست و بقولی
lines.en: it are eight stars. The Heart of the Lion (Qalb al-Asad) is of the first magnitude in it. Virgo (Sunbula) has twenty-eight stars, and according to a saying

lines.text: بیست و شش وصورت دیگر میزان هشت کوکب و خارج از صورت نه کوکب بر مثال ترازو
lines.en: twenty-six. And another constellation is Libra (Mizan), eight stars, and outside the constellation are nine stars in the example of a balance.

sections.text: و ستاق کوکبی است از قدر سیم بر سر انعام که بر صورت مردیست
sections.en: And Sataq is a star of the third magnitude on the head of the cattle, which is in the shape of a man.

sections.text: دیگر را که بر صورت زنیست و صورت دیگر ذات الکرسی است و صورت دیگر ذات الکرسی است
sections.en: Another which is in the shape of a woman, and another constellation is Cassiopeia (Dhat al-Kursi), and another constellation is Cassiopeia.

sections.text: بر مثال ترازو که انرا میزان خوانند
sections.en: In the example of a balance, which they call Libra (Mizan).

sections.en: This is the constellation of the northern stars. But the zodiac signs: First, Hamal with thirteen stars. Another is Thawr with thirty-three stars, and on it is one of the first magnitude in the hand. Another is Jawzā' with eighteen stars, and outside it are seven stars in the shape of two standing stars, and hands on shoulders placed on each other. Saratān has eight stars, and outside it are four stars. Asad has twenty-seven stars, and outside it are eight stars. Qalb al-Asad is of the first magnitude in it. Sunbulah has twenty-eight stars, and according to one saying twenty-six. And another constellation is Mīzān with eight stars, and outside the constellation are nine stars in the shape of a balance.

summary.headline: Northern Constellations and Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Description of northern constellations and zodiac signs, including the Bearer of the Demon's Head, Holder of the Reins, Ophiuchus, Serpent, Arrow, Eagle, Greater Horse, Andromeda, Triangle, and their star counts and figures. The zodiac listing covers Aries through Libra, with notable stars such as Capella and Qalb al-Asad.
